AUTHOR: Westergerling
TITLE: Effects of fish behaviour on abundance and length frequency estimates from in-trawl stereo cameras
SPECIES: Atlantic herring, blue whiting, mesopelagic fishes (Maurolicus muelleri, Benthosema glaciale, myctophids); model also outputs Atlantic mackerel
DATA: Own Deep Vision in-trawl stereo images, 3 pelagic trawl stations, IESNS 2018
V_EV: Image collection: 'synchronised LED strobes for illumination'; Table 2 trawl layer depths 206–363 m; distance to camera Z computed per fish (Eq. 4)
D2: no training in this study; pre-trained RetinaNet of Allken et al. (2021) applied
D_EV: Automatic image analysis: 'conducted with a deep learning algorithm developed by Allken et al. (2021) based on the RetinaNet object detection network' (training split not described)
R_EV: Datasets: 'The same images were also analysed using the RetinaNet deep learning algorithm developed by Allken et al. (2021)' (training domain not stated)
C_EV: Table 6: 'automatic detections with a score threshold of 0.47'; Results: discrepancy automatic detections vs individuals 'highest for herring (8–13 times higher)'
E_EV: Fig. 9: 'composition of taxa... calculated from three different methods: manual IA, trawl catches, and detections generated by RetinaNet'; Table 6 mesopelagics 'missed 54% of the time'
ARCH: RetinaNet (Allken et al. 2021), image-by-image, no tracking
METR: recall per taxon, confusion matrix (TP/FN only), detection counts vs manual counts and catch
NOTE: Mainly a behaviour/recurrence study with manual annotation; AI part = evaluation of an existing RetinaNet (Allken 2021). Training data of that model not described here, so external status cannot be judged -> R1=N (verify Allken 2021 training years; if trained on other surveys, R1=Y). C5 coded because duplicate counting by the detector is quantified (detections vs individuals, Table 5) with reported threshold 0.47 -> C_ALL=Y mechanically; no handling mechanism implemented. Independent reference = trawl catch counts (Table 5/Fig. 9). ENV: pelagic Norwegian Sea 200-360 m, no matching category -> NR. NIMG = total images recorded at 3 stations; 3674 manual annotations compared.
